description: Crossfades a chain of two to eight inputs down to one output

params.text: Sweeps the output along the chain of active inputs, crossfading between each neighbouring pair.
Sets how many inputs take part, from two to eight; a lamp marks each input that is in the chain.

inputs.text: One of the inputs in the morph chain; it reaches the output as the morph sweeps past it, and an unpatched jack contributes 0V.
Moves the morph a tenth of the knob's travel along the chain per volt.

inputs.8:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
